verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents a dedicated data transport API with RPC between participants, byte streams for arbitrary binary data, and data tracks for continuous low-latency telemetry. Access tokens include a canPublishData grant, so data travels in the same room as published audio and video tracks. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of data-channel latency, and documented details on delivery guarantees and message-size limits.

support.subject: As a developer, participants exchange low-latency arbitrary data in the session alongside audio and video, with a documented data API

citations.quote: Stream continuous, low-latency data for robotics, IoT, and telemetry use cases.
Use byte streams to transfer files, images, or any other binary data.
Use RPC to execute custom methods on other participants in the room and await a response.
canPublishData — Allow participant to publish data to the room
